verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. The REST endpoints and the spec are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
